verdict.rationale: Firecrawl provides webhooks for job status/failure notifications (crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, monitor check start/progress/finish) with HMAC verification for security, which covers alerting on failures. However, there's no evidence of dedicated data-quality validation tooling, job performance dashboards/metrics, or SLA monitoring beyond basic webhook events and an audit log stream. Missing for 10: dashboards/metrics for job performance monitoring, data quality validation features, independent corroboration of alerting reliability in production use.
